name: herdr-jutsu
description: Raise an isolated crew inside Herdr — brief once, wait on a literal pane id, pull bounded results, handle blocked members, and hand long jobs to a fresh session.

interface.shortDescription: Raise an isolated crew in Herdr, wait on literal pane ids, and pull bounded results from Claude Code or Codex.
interface.longDescription: Raise and run a crew inside Herdr: extra terminal panes and full Claude or Codex sessions that are long-lived, visible, steerable, and replaceable. Members never message the parent. The parent briefs once, waits on the literal pane id from the trusted spawn line, and pulls a bounded FINAL response. Codex members receive a child-only project deny policy plus -a never, reported as enforced_if_trusted because project rules require repository trust. Claude members receive a string-pattern deny for herdr, SendMessage, and ListAgents, reported as partial. Shell members are not isolated. A Codex parent still needs user-approved rules for the literal herdr commands it runs outside its sandbox; the launcher never edits user rules.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to name and place a crew member for this stream.
I am a Codex session inside Herdr — walk me through raising a Claude child and hearing back from it.
Walk me through jutsu-spawn.sh's preflight and exit codes before I spawn a reviewer pane.
